blocks.text: The fastest way is the request form — We see it immediately. WhatsApp works too: a photo of the problem halves the conversation.
You build the job on the home page
The calculator on the first screen prices the work as you pick it — tick what needs doing and send it in one click. Rather not click? Call or write on WhatsApp.
All of Warsaw and 25 km around it. The minimum visit inside the city is 246 zł.
Outside Warsaw — message us and We'll check the trip.
Describe the problem, get a price
Write on WhatsApp or call: a photo and one sentence are enough for a price. Or price the whole job yourself — in the calculator on the home page.
